newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day tender at fixed 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of 3.00 percent.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow and the securities have to be repurchased on Sept 11.
A 65.0 billion mark facility set at a fixed 3.30 percent expires on Wednesday. A 14-day facility of 69 billion marks set last week also carried a fixed interest rate of 3.30 percent.
The German central bank last Thursday lowered the repo rate to a fixed 3.00 percent for the next two weekly tenders.
